I purchased two cool sculpting applicators, one for the back of each of my arms. My arms have always been a trouble area where I collect extra fat. My stomach even felt flatter and I felt thinner. It's definitely great to do before a big event or trip! I would highly recommend! I received the treatment before going to Vegas for my birthday and received countless compliments on how good my abs looked in my outfit.
